ops.body: - A moment's own place (MC18, decision 0202), left for later: between towns the context line can only say the state, since a road's name or a county needs the map read there (the street cache holds only where streets were derived); a session still open has no areas until Stop, so its moments name no town until then; `contextFor` reads every outing's area rows once per batch (n: outings times the areas each crossed, a few thousand rows over years; a per-outing read would need a new `Db` method and its contract case); `MomentView.place` in `resurface/views.ts` still carries the outing's one name and nothing reads it

argv: From the outing journey's second audit (2026-11-18)
A moment captured on the drive between towns
